Planning a Website Support Bot: Scope, Escalation and Operating Cost

A support bot should earn its place by resolving a defined class of questions. Begin with the requests your team actually receives, the answers you can maintain and the point where a person must take over. A confident response is not useful if it conceals missing information.
Define the questions the assistant may answer
Budget for monitoring as well as model usage
Select a bounded support task
Recognise when a simpler contact route is enough
Test an unanswered question before launch

Use a small evaluation set containing supported questions, ambiguous requests, outdated information and a request involving private data. Record whether the system answers from an approved source, asks a useful clarification or hands off. Do not give a public chatbot broad account permissions merely to make a demonstration impressive. Separate a draft answer from any action that changes a booking, order or record. Provider pricing and feature availability change; verify the selected product's current terms before budgeting rather than treating the figures in a general article as a permanent quote.

Website and WhatsApp Handoffs: Keep Enquiries Recoverable

A customer can discover a service on a website and continue in WhatsApp, but the two stages need a clear handoff. The site should identify the service and explain whether opening the messaging application merely starts a conversation or creates a request the business can retrieve.
Identify the messaging product in use
Check current messaging rules with the provider
Give service information a stable public home
Carry a reference into the conversation
Track accepted requests separately from contact clicks
Make the message link minimal and deliberate

Construct a click-to-chat link from the business's verified number and URL-encode a neutral message or product reference. Avoid including private names, health details or document links in the URL. Opening the app does not establish that the visitor sent a message. If the website itself accepts an enquiry, store it before showing a reference and make duplicate retries recover the same record. Check current product limits, messaging permissions and charges in the official provider documentation; this guide does not establish a specific policy change on an assumed date.

Price the work that changes hands

A business cannot guarantee that a search engine or AI summary will cite its website. It can publish clear service information, keep facts accurate and make useful pages accessible. Evaluate that work on the quality of the source, not an invented formula for citation.
Identify what a generated summary does and does not establish
Describe the local decision the page should support
Use accurate source information without a citation guarantee
Check the public page before adding more markup
Verify a summary against the underlying page

When reviewing a generated description of a business, open the cited source and compare the exact claim. A correct address does not establish a correct price or qualification. Maintain visible authorship, dates and a correction route where appropriate. Structured data must agree with visible facts and should not invent reviews or outcomes. Record a mistaken summary as an observation; it does not prove which private ranking signal or generation step caused the error.
